# Group reflections

Original OOXML controls generated by `tools/group_reflection_fixture.py`; no
corpus content, external artwork or third-party font binaries are included.
The reference application opened the exact file read-only and exported `native.pdf`.
`tools/group_reflection_reference.py` renders the PDF at 96 DPI and binds hashes
for the source, PDF and PNG.

Twelve asymmetric paths test all four horizontal/vertical flip combinations
with zero rotation, 30-degree rotation, and a nested reflected/rotated child in
a 90-degree outer group. Nonuniform scale, nonzero child origins, and artwork
outside group bounds are included. ECMA-376 Part 1 section 20.1.7.5 defines group
reflection about the frame center. These controls establish its composition
with the existing reference rotation/scale behavior.

The browser compares both directions of each color's pixel mask against the reference application:
at least 99% must have a counterpart within one pixel, with at least 500 pixels
per shape. This permits raster edge differences while detecting omitted, clipped,
misplaced or incorrectly reflected artwork. Editing, export/reopen, unrelated
package parts and exact undo are checked. Source transforms remain immutable.
Text inside reflected groups remains explicitly guarded pending native text
orientation controls; this fixture does not establish that behavior.
